title: 'What happened to me is proof that Hong Kong is no longer Hong Kong': Antoine Védeilhé
summary: An international award-winning documentary maker has told FRANCE 24 that his expulsion from Hong Kong proves that the city is no longer what it was. Antoine Védeilhé has been covering Hong Kong for years and was aiming to make a documentary about how life has changed there under Chinese rule.
